Editorial

Care for the idea. Attention to the page.

From an early concept to a developed manuscript, choose support that fits your project. Scope, pricing, and timeline are agreed in a proposal before booking.

Idea & Concept Consultation

60 minutes · $150

Includes a written summary of recommendations.

Manuscript Assessment

$0.015–$0.020 per word

Includes an editorial letter and follow-up consultation.

Manuscript Editing

$0.03–$0.05 per word

Depending on scope and level of editing. Developmental editing considers structure and argument; line editing attends to expression and flow; copyediting addresses clarity and consistency at the sentence level. The scope is agreed in the proposal.

Book proposal development & publishing coaching

Inquire for scope and pricing

Support for shaping a book proposal and discussing the publishing process, with the work defined around your project.

Theological review

Theological review is included in all editing and consultation services, with attention to clarity, consistency, and responsible interpretation of Scripture while respecting your stated theological commitments.
